name: Mouhamed Gueye
detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Devin Carter
detail: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

name: Noah Clowney
detail: Clowney (illness) was downgraded to questionable for Friday's game versus Detroit, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Egor Demin
detail: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

name: Tyler Bilodeau
detail: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

name: Dennis Schroder
detail: Schroder (foot) is probable for Friday against the Wizards.

name: Kon Knueppel
detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday. He remains out for Friday's contest against the Wizards.

name: Coby White
detail: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

name: Grant Williams
detail: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

name: Kylan Boswell
detail: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

name: Jalen Smith
detail: Smith is questionable for Friday's game against Boston with a left finger sprain.

name: Tobe Awaka
detail: Awaka (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.

name: Nic Claxton
detail: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

name: Meleek Thomas
detail: Thomas (foot) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Hawks, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

name: Tarik Biberovic
detail: Biberovic (heel) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game versus the Rockets.

name: Santi Aldama

name: Dereck Lively II
detail: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

name: Cameron Johnson
detail: Johnson (ankle) is expected to play in Friday's game against the Suns, per John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM.

name: Alpha Diallo
detail: Diallo (personal) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Suns.

name: Spencer Jones
detail: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Isaiah Joe

name: Jalen Duren
detail: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Gui Santos
detail: Santos (knee) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
detail: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

name: Moses Moody
detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Reed Sheppard

name: Alperen Sengun
detail: Sengun (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.

detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

name: Andrew Nembhard
detail: Nembhard (neck) is listed as probable for Friday's game against Miami.

name: Aaron Nesmith
detail: Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Friday's game against the Heat.

name: Ivica Zubac
detail: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

detail: Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle stated McConnell (hamstring) is "doing better" and "getting closer" to a return, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

name: Ben Sheppard

name: Tyrese Haliburton
detail: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Johnny Furphy
detail: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

name: Rui Hachimura
detail: Hachimura (quadriceps) is probable for Friday's game against Minnesota, per Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
detail: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Max Strus
detail: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
detail: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Bradley Beal
detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller

name: Adou Thiero
detail: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

name: Ziaire Williams
detail: Williams (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against Golden State.

name: Simone Fontecchio
detail: Fontecchio (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Indiana.

name: Anthony Edwards

name: Jordan Poole

name: Chet Holmgren

name: Alex Caruso

name: Thomas Sorber

name: Nikola Topic
detail: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

name: Cason Wallace
detail: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Jonathan Isaac
detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game in Toronto.

name: Jalen Suggs

name: Paolo Banchero

name: Noah Penda

name: Oso Ighodaro

name: Mark Williams
detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Ja Morant

name: Robert Williams III
detail: Williams (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against Memphis, Casey Holdahl of the Trail Blazers' official site reports.

name: Chris Youngblood
detail: Youngblood (ankle/two-way player) is out for Tuesday's game against the Lakers.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Dylan Cardwell
detail: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Maxime Raynaud

name: Keegan Murray
detail: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

name: Ben Simmons
detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Tobias Harris
detail: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Utah, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.

name: Jayden Quaintance
detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
detail: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

name: Nate Bittle

name: Lauri Markkanen

name: Trey Alexander

name: Jusuf Nurkic

name: Tre Johnson
detail: Johnson (Achilles) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Charlotte.

name: Justin Champagnie
detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
